books_start_meaning: First day of the Zoho books (the organisation started in March 2025). The party-account ledger is always read from this day, so that every party's balance includes its opening entries.
stock_ledger_account_meaning: update-18: the stock account whose ledger is read to explain the gap between the Trial Balance and the items booked to it (the Closing Stock tab). It is looked up by name among the stock accounts of the Trial Balance; leave it out to skip that call.
party_account_ids_meaning: The 11 supplier / creditor / advance accounts known at FY26. The ledger is always asked for these PLUS any party account found in the live Trial Balance - so an account that nets to zero (and is hidden from a non-zero Trial Balance) can not hide offsetting party balances.
register_history_budget_meaning: update-29/30: at most this many fixed assets are read from Zoho in one refresh when Redis is in use. Each asset costs up to two calls: its entries (acquisition and depreciation, update-29) and its settings (the rate and the residual value, update-30). FY26 has 483 assets that are not drafts, so eight runs on an empty cache; the first seven continue by themselves, a minute apart. They are kept 35 days, so later refreshes read none. An asset kept by update-29 (entries only) is completed with one call. Without Redis (local test) all are read each time.
cwip_journal_budget_meaning: update-20: at most this many journals and bills behind the CWIP and IAUD accounts are read from Zoho in one refresh when Redis is in use (FY26 needs 137 journals and, since update-22, 35 bills; the bills are read first, and the ones already cached are free); until all are known the CWIP tab keeps its signed park table. Without Redis (local test) all are read each time.
